title: Scorpio Moon:
all about you.
summary: What Vedic astrology reads in a Scorpio Moon: Mars, water, the gift and the catch, love, work, and the three birth stars inside the sign.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Scorpio flag, with a scorpion beside her
inside: Mars, water and the fixed quality, and what each is read to give you
The gift and the catch, then love, work, money and energy
The three birth stars inside Scorpio, in a table you can look yourself up in
Five things to do with a Scorpio Moon
intro: If the Moon was in Scorpio when you were born, Vedic astrology reads you as someone who feels everything and shows very little. Calm on the surface, a great deal going on underneath. The film says that in sixty seconds. This guide takes the long way round: where that nature is said to come from, what it is good for, where it gets heavy, and how the tradition tells one Scorpio Moon from another.

A note before you start. Everything here is what the tradition reads from the sign, said as a tendency and never as a rule. Your Moon sign is one part of a chart, and the rest of your chart, your upbringing and your own choices all shape how much of this you recognise.

sections.label: What you are made of
title: Mars, water,
and a sign that holds.
paragraphs: Every sign has a ruler, an element and a quality. For Scorpio those are Mars, water and fixed. Put together they explain most of what is said about the sign: a fighter's energy, carried in feeling, held steady for a long time.

Scorpio is the eighth of the twelve signs, and its opposite sign, Taurus, is the sign of comfort and the things we keep. Scorpio is read as the other side of that coin: what lies under the surface, what changes us, and what we share with another person.

One more classical detail, because people ask about it. The old texts name Scorpio as the sign where the Moon is at its weakest, which is often described in frightening words online. Read plainly, it means feelings here run deep and are not easily calmed by outside comfort. The same depth is what gives this Moon its insight, its loyalty and its staying power.

items.name: The ruler: Mars
items.text: Mars is the warrior among the planets: red, brave and direct. Mars also rules Aries, where that force shows on the outside. In Scorpio it is said to turn inward. The fight becomes focus, the courage becomes the nerve to face hard truths, and the energy goes into one thing at a time, very deeply.

items.name: The element: water
items.text: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces are the three water signs. Water is read as feeling, memory and intuition. It takes the shape of what holds it and it remembers where it has been. In Scorpio the water is the still, deep kind: quiet on top and strong underneath.

items.name: The quality: fixed
items.text: Signs are movable, fixed or dual. Scorpio is fixed, along with Taurus, Leo and Aquarius. Fixed signs are read as keepers: they hold their course, their people and their opinions. That is where the famous Scorpio loyalty comes from, and also the difficulty letting go.

sections.label: The gift and the catch
title: Loyalty first,
letting go later.
paragraphs: The gift is loyalty. Once a Scorpio Moon has decided you are one of its people, the tradition reads that as a decision for good. You tend to show up when it is hard, keep secrets without being asked, and protect the people you love quietly and thoroughly. Few signs are said to be as steady in a crisis.

The catch is letting go. The same depth that makes the loyalty real also makes hurt last. You are read as slow to forgive and slower still to forget, and you may keep a careful note of who let you down. The tradition is kind about this: the memory is protection, not cruelty. But carrying every old hurt is heavy, and the person it weighs on most is you.

sections.label: Love
title: All in,
or not at all.
paragraphs: In love a Scorpio Moon is said to go all in. You tend to want the whole truth, the whole person and a bond that goes past the surface. Half measures and small talk are not your idea of romance.

items.name: What you bring
items.text: Intensity, devotion and attention. You notice what your partner does not say, remember what matters to them, and stand by them when things get difficult. Being loved by this Moon is read as being truly seen.

items.name: What you need
items.text: Honesty, privacy and time. Trust is said to be built slowly with you, one kept promise at a time. You need a partner who does not play games and who respects that you will not share everything at once.

items.name: What tends to go wrong
items.text: Silence and testing. Feeling hurt and saying nothing, waiting to see whether the other person notices, or holding on to an old injury long after it was apologised for. The fix the tradition suggests is simple and hard: say the feeling while it is still small.

items.name: Work
items.text: At work a Scorpio Moon is read as the one who digs. Give it a mystery, a problem nobody else can crack, or a subject to master, and it will not stop until it is solved. Research, investigation, strategy, healing work, finance, crisis work and anything that rewards focus and discretion are said to suit this Moon.

items.name: With a boss or a team
items.text: You are said to work best with trust and a free hand, and to go quiet when you are micromanaged or kept in the dark. You notice office politics quickly. Choose one or two people to trust openly; it makes the rest easier.

items.name: Money
items.text: In plain terms the tradition reads this Moon as private and strategic about money, and interested in what is shared, inherited or built over time rather than spent quickly. It says nothing certain about how much you will have. The habit said to help most is being as open about money with a partner as you would want them to be with you.

items.name: Energy
items.text: Your energy tends to go deep rather than wide. You can work for hours on one thing and then need real time alone to recover. Water needs to move to stay clear, so anything that lets feelings out, from writing to swimming to a long honest talk, is read as good for this Moon.

sections.label: Look yourself up
title: The three birth stars
inside Scorpio.
paragraphs: The sky is also divided into twenty-seven birth stars, called nakshatras, each 13°20′ wide. Parts of three of them fall inside the thirty degrees of Scorpio. Which one your Moon was in is your birth star, and the tradition uses it to tell one Scorpio Moon from another. Each star has a ruling planet of its own, which colours the Mars and water underneath. Your chart shows the degree of your Moon in its sign; find it in the left column.

rows.note: The forked branch, the star of a goal. Only its last quarter is in Scorpio; the rest is in Libra. Read as the most driven Scorpio Moon: it picks a target and keeps going until it gets there. The catch is impatience with anything in the way.

The star of friendship and devotion. Read as the warmest Scorpio Moon: loyal to friends, good at keeping people together, and able to do well far from home. The catch is holding on to people and old hurts for too long.

The eldest, the star of the protector. Read as the most responsible Scorpio Moon: it takes charge, looks after others and carries a lot. The catch is feeling that everything rests on you, and not asking for help.

after: If your Moon sits within a degree of one of these borders, the exact time of birth decides which side it falls on. All three are still Scorpio, with Mars as the sign ruler. The birth star adds a second voice, it does not replace the first.

sections.label: What to do
title: Five habits
for a Scorpio Moon.
paragraphs: None of this is about becoming lighter or more open than you want to be. It is about giving a deep, loyal nature room to breathe.

steps.name: Say one feeling out loud
steps.text: Before it gets heavy, say it: one sentence, to one person you trust. Small and early is far easier than big and late, for you and for them.

steps.name: Choose what to keep
steps.text: You remember everything, so decide on purpose what is worth carrying. Write the old hurt down once, then let the page hold it instead of you.

steps.name: Give trust in steps
steps.text: Not everyone has to earn all of you at once. Let people earn a little trust, then a little more. It protects you and gives them a fair chance.

steps.name: Put your focus somewhere useful
steps.text: That digging mind needs a mystery. Give it a real one, a skill, a project, a subject to master, so it does not turn on your own worries instead.

steps.name: Make time to be alone, then come back
steps.text: Time on your own is how this Moon recharges, and that is fine. Just tell the people close to you that you are recharging, not pulling away.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads your nature and your timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Scorpio Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Scorpio. Many people with a Scorpio Sun have their Moon somewhere else, and Vedic signs are counted from the stars, so even your Sun sign may differ. Your birth chart shows your Moon sign in a few seconds.

faq.q: How do I find my birth star?
faq.a: From the degree of your Moon, which your birth chart shows. The Moon moves about thirteen degrees a day, so you need your date, place and time of birth. Draw your chart on the home page and look for the Moon’s sign and degree.

note: Sign rulers, elements, qualities and birth stars are those of the classical tradition. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, Lahiri ayanamsa, read by Moon sign.
